question: Which of the following Indian states had the honour of hosting the 38th National Games in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **38th edition** of the **National Games** is officially scheduled to be hosted by the state of **Uttarakhand** in the year **2025**.
 
• The **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)**, led by its President **P.T. Usha**, confirmed the dates for the event, which will take place from **January 28 to February 14, 2025**.
 
• This marks a significant milestone for **Uttarakhand**, as it will be the first time the state hosts the summer version of the National Games, having previously hosted the **Winter National Games**.
 
• The games will be spread across several cities in the state, including **Dehradun**, **Haldwani**, **Haridwar**, **Rudrapur**, and **Rishikesh**, to utilize existing and newly developed sports infrastructure.
 
• Chief Minister **Pushkar Singh Dhami** has been actively overseeing the preparations, emphasizing that the event will showcase **Uttarakhand's** culture and hospitality while promoting a sports culture in the Himalayan region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Goa (37th National Games)**:
 
 
• The **37th National Games** were held in **Goa** in **2023** (October-November).
 
• It featured over **10,000 athletes** competing in **43 different sports** disciplines.
 
• **Maharashtra** topped the medal tally in the **2023** edition, winning the **Raja Bhalindra Singh Trophy**.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat (36th National Games)**:
 
 
• The **36th National Games** took place in **Gujarat** in **2022** after a gap of seven years.
 
• The event was held across six cities: **Ahmedabad**, **Gandhinagar**, **Surat**, **Vadodara**, **Rajkot**, and **Bhavnagar**.
 
• The **Services Sports Control Board (SSCB)** emerged as the overall champion during this edition.
 
 
 
• **History of National Games**:
 
 
• The first-ever **Indian Olympic Games** (later renamed National Games) were held in **1924** in **Lahore** (undivided India).
 
• The **first modern National Games** on the lines of the Olympics were held in **New Delhi** in **1985**.
 
• The primary objective of these games is to identify and nurture athletic talent for international competitions like the **Olympics** and **Asian Games**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Infrastructure and Disciplines**: For the **2025** games, **Uttarakhand** is preparing to host **38 sports disciplines**. Major venues include the **Maharana Pratap Sports College** in **Dehradun** and the **Indira Gandhi International Cricket Stadium** in **Haldwani**.
 
• **Mascot and Symbolism**: The state often uses regional symbols like the **Himalayan Monal** (state bird) or the **Himalayan Musk Deer** (state animal) to represent its sporting identity; the **2025** edition aims to highlight "Green Games" to promote environmental sustainability.
 
• **Future Editions**: Following **Uttarakhand**, the state of **Meghalaya** has been lined up by the **IOA** as a potential future host for the **39th National Games**, continuing the trend of taking national sports to the North-Eastern and Himalayan states.
 
• **Governing Body**: The **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** is the body responsible for selecting host states and managing the schedule. It was established in **1927**.
